entries.dictionary: 精選版 日本国語大辞典; 普及版 字通
entries.heading: 償（ショウ）; 字音ショウ・字訓つぐなう
entries.evidence: Nikkoku supplies recompense/compensation noun senses under しょう and the related native nouns. Jitsu explicitly gives seventeen strokes, ショウ, つぐなう and compensation/return/recompense meanings.
entries.decision: Retain exact frozen character readings and order. Explain compensation or making amends without restricting every compound to monetary damages or moral wrongdoing. Canonical radical remains 人 with visible 亻.
entries.limits: Daijisen returned attribution only. Jitsu explicitly identifies 賞 as phonetic, but ancient-form and quoted-character gaiji are images not inspected here. Do not claim a complete historical reconstruction; use a labelled modern-shape mnemonic instead.

entries.dictionary: デジタル大辞泉; 精選版 日本国語大辞典
entries.heading: つぐな・う【償う】; つぐの・う【償う】
entries.evidence: Daijisen distinguishes making up debts/losses with money or goods and making amends for wrongdoing through money, goods or actions; labels the verb godan and gives the potential form. Nikkoku identifies a transitive godan verb and explicitly says つぐなう is the form much used today, derived from つぐのう.
entries.decision: Select 償う つぐなう as necessary support for つぐな.う. Teach the loss or wrongdoing object with を and ordinary godan forms. Preserve the complete frozen つぐのう alternative without adding it to the kanji metadata, asserting it is nonexistent, or treating it as the modern teaching default.
entries.limits: The aggregator also returns a separate historical まよう headword and older つぐのう senses. Those do not change the frozen two-reading character record or establish unrestricted modern variants. Source examples inform construction choice; future original examples still require independent review.

entries.dictionary: 精選版 日本国語大辞典; 日本大百科全書; 改訂新版 世界大百科事典; 普及版 字通
entries.heading: ほ‐しょう【補償】; 補償（法律）ほしょう
entries.evidence: Nikkoku distinguishes making good a deficiency or loss, a specific lawful-public-action compensation sense, damages and psychology. The encyclopedia entries distinguish a narrower legal use from broader compensation usage; the World Encyclopedia opening expressly allows broader use that can include damages. Jitsu defines making good a loss.
entries.decision: Select exact 補償 ほしょう for ショウ, supported jointly by the complete unrestricted JMdict family, raw 補ホ/償ショウ records and the public headword. Focus on compensation for loss. Do not teach an absolute rule that 補償 always excludes damages, that it covers all harm automatically, or that it promises liability/coverage without stated conditions.
entries.limits: Daijisen and Mypedia sections returned attribution only. The bounded 9000-character response returned substantial legal/psychology text, but no current-law audit or specialist acceptance is claimed. Historical legal examples, dates and psychological theories are not adopted as practical teaching claims.

entries.dictionary: 精選版 日本国語大辞典
entries.heading: おぎな・う【補】
entries.evidence: Nikkoku gives supplying what is insufficient and a separate making-good-damage-or-wrongdoing sense. The exact frozen JMdict 補う family independently includes making up for losses. This supports overlap rather than a categorical moral-versus-material divide.
entries.decision: Keep the existing useful comparison and propose only a link to the new 補償 article. Plan direct quiz safeguards based on the actual displayed loss-covering meanings, without rewriting the existing easier-level word or inventing a universal substitution rule.
entries.limits: Daijisen returned attribution only. Older おぎぬう/おぎのう entries and the etymological discussion are not adopted into the new card's metadata or teaching.
